routeComponentRule: Each listed component names the one fixed HTTP route beneath its stated loopback origin. The implementation supplies the normal HTTP separator internally; no caller, model, action argument, environment value, or generic router selects a URI.

harnessManifest.artifactVerification: The harness computes artifactSha256 before each process starts and compares it, the exact owner checkpoint commit, runtime name, endpoint, protocol range, and capability declaration with its immutable per-run manifest.
harnessManifest.selfDescriptionRule: Runtime self-description is checked only against the harness-pinned manifest. It is not evidence by itself.

pairAuthentication.method: per-run 256-bit pair capability with HMAC-SHA-256 challenge-response
pairAuthentication.secretDelivery: The harness sends each pair capability after process start over a one-shot inherited anonymous OS pipe. The capability is retained in process memory only and is absent from command lines, environment variables, action arguments, model content, ordinary logs, and fixture content.
pairAuthentication.requestProof: The caller sends runId, a fresh 128-bit client nonce, and HMAC(pairCapability, 'FATES-SLICE-002/attestation/v1|request|runId|nonce|method|path|sha256(requestBytes)').
pairAuthentication.responseProof: The receiver returns its canonical identity payload and HMAC(pairCapability, 'FATES-SLICE-002/attestation/v1|response|runId|nonce|sha256(canonicalIdentityPayload)').
pairAuthentication.loggingRule: Authentication headers and capability material are redacted before any ordinary log, relay evidence, or returned result is written.

moiraeVerifiesHorae: The listener is exactly http://127.0.0.1:48202 and proves knowledge of the Moirae-Horae pair capability.
The challenge-bound identity payload exactly matches the harness manifest for runtime name, runId, instance ID, commit, artifact digest, endpoint, protocol, capability, and request schema digest.
The Horae readiness observation is healthy, registered, complete, compatible, and no older than 1,000 ms.
horaeVerifiesAnanke: The listener is exactly http://127.0.0.1:48201 and proves knowledge of the Horae-Ananke pair capability.
The challenge-bound identity payload exactly matches the harness manifest for runtime name, runId, instance ID, commit, artifact digest, endpoint, protocol, and exact action capability.
Immediately before dispatch, Ananke registration, readiness, health, compatibility, capability, and identity are rechecked and must be no older than 1,000 ms.

admissionInvalidators: HMAC failure, missing proof, nonce reuse, or a runId mismatch
runtime, instance, commit, artifact digest, checkpoint, endpoint, protocol, capability, schema, or readiness mismatch
unexpected process restart, endpoint rebind, listener collision, identity drift, incomplete registration, unhealthy dependency, or freshness age above 1,000 ms
attempt to source a principal, capability, action value, fixture location, or attestation secret from model content or action arguments
independentHarnessChecks: Verify artifact digest before spawn and record the process ID, start time, fixed endpoint, and manifest digest.
Verify the one-shot pipe is delivered only to the expected process in the recorded run and is closed after delivery.
Attempt wrong-capability, wrong-run, stale-nonce, artifact-drift, endpoint-drift, and restart cases; each must fail before dispatch.
Assert that secret material is absent from action payloads, returned fixture content, and ordinary logs.
explicitNonDecision: This local design does not introduce production PKI, transport credentials, a generic identity protocol, or a Runtime Contracts change. Loopback transport alone is never accepted as identity proof.
